title: Crayfisher
text:
Web Modelling Platform Development

Platform for Integration of Models with Data
We build cloud-native platforms that transform static simulations into dynamic software assets. By linking numerical engines with real-time field observations, we ensure models adapt continuously.

  
    Living Models Powered by Live Data
    
      Traditional modeling relies on static files compiled at specific milestones. Our web platforms automate the ingestion of field data directly into numerical setups.
    
    
      By integrating models into cloud infrastructures, we enable automated re-calibration, sensitivity checks, and real-time visualization of hydrogeological datasets.
    
    
       Model-Data Integration: Unifying live telemetry and sensor networks with simulation runs.
       AI Orchestration: Agentic systems that decide when to re-run, re-calibrate, and validate models as new data arrives — turning raw streams into trusted results.
       Automated Workflows: Orchestrating background computations as new data streams arrive.
       Stakeholder Accessibility: Secure, intuitive dashboards for scenario exploration without desktop GUIs.

title: Crayfisher
text:
Consulting Services
We provide expert numerical modeling and engineering consulting. Our workflows are designed from day one to be programmatic, version-controlled, and ready for integration with modern web applications and artificial intelligence.

  
    
      
      Scripted MODFLOW
      MODFLOW models fully scripted for fast development, complete reproducibility, and standard-setting modern workflow efficiency.
    
  
  
  
    
      
      Applied Hydrology
      Specialized simulations for mine dewatering, water resources management, environmental impact assessment, and brine resource estimation.
    
  
  
  
    
      
      Uncertainty Analysis
      Advanced parameter estimation and uncertainty analysis utilizing PEST to quantify model reliability and mitigate decision risk.
    
  

  
    
      
      Automated Workflows
      Designed from the start for automated workflow execution and seamless updatability as new environmental data arrives.
    
  

  
    
      
      AI Integration
      Engineered with programmatic APIs and clean data schemas, ready for seamless integration with AI agents and analytical engines.
    
  

  
    
      
      Transparency & Compatibility
      Full version control and clean documentation for total transparency, designed to be fully compatible with our modern web platform.
    
  



“We aren’t just running simulations; we’re building the next generation of living tools that evolve with your data.”

title: Our Philosophy
text:
Because a model that isn’t alive is already obsolete.
We believe water management shouldn’t rely on static reports and manual data entry. We exist to replace outdated, fragmented tools with autonomous systems that think, update, and correct in real-time—turning modeling from a project milestone into a living utility.

title: Our Philosophy
text:
The Crayfisher Values

Live by Design
If a model isn’t self-updating, it’s expiring. We build systems that reflect reality now, not reality six months ago.


Agentic Oversight
We replace manual “button-clicking” with intelligent agents. We value autonomous workflows that free humans for high-level decision-making.


Tooling the Future
Legacy GUIs are the bottleneck. We build modern, programmatic tools designed for AI integration, not human limitation.


Radical Efficiency
If it can be automated, it must be. We eliminate manual ingestion errors to focus on what matters: the insight.
